reason: RuntimeError: AllocBuffer: error condition NRT_RESOURCE == rt_status: Not enough Neuron memory on core 0 for size=262540032. Device HBM was at 15.596 GB (core 0) and 15.614 GB (core 1) of the 16 GB per-core budget when a further 250 MiB allocation was refused.
why_this_is_a_result_and_not_just_a_cras: The published SFT lane runs Llama-3.1-8B LoRA at seq 2048 on this same chip at 68.3% MFU. ORPO at max_length 2048 does not fit, because a preference step forwards chosen AND rejected -- the activation footprint of a 2048-token preference step is that of a 4096-token supervised step. Preference training therefore runs out of memory one rung of the sequence ladder EARLIER than supervised fine-tuning on identical hardware. That is a concrete capacity-planning fact, and it is the reason the ORPO ladder in this study stops at 1024.
distinct_from_the_pretrain_ceiling: The pretraining lane hit NCC_EOOM001 at seq 2048, which is a COMPILE-time refusal by neuronx-cc (16.20 GB predicted vs a 16.00 GB limit). This is a RUNTIME refusal by the Neuron runtime: the graph compiled and the allocation failed during execution. Both are the 16 GiB per-core ceiling; they are reported by different layers and a practitioner will see different error text.
